  a.user_id,
  u.name AS user_name,
  a.recurrence,
  a.day_of_week,
  a.day_of_month,
  a.start_time,
  a.end_time,
  a.start_date::text,
  a.end_date::text,
  a.biweekly_reference_date::text,
  COUNT(*) OVER() AS total
FROM
  availability_rules a
INNER JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
WHERE
  -- 1. Tu filtro de búsqueda global existente (agrupado entre paréntesis)
  (
    COALESCE($1, '') = '' OR
    (
      u.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      -- a.recurrence ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.day_of_week::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.start_time::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.end_time::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.end_date::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    )
  )
  -- 2. NUEVO: Filtro opcional por user_id ($4)
  AND ($4 IS NULL OR $4::text = '' OR a.user_id = $4)
ORDER BY
  a.start_date DESC
LIMIT
  {{ $2 || 100 }}
OFFSET
  {{ (($3 || 1) - 1) * ($2 || 100) }};

SELECT
  a.id,
  a.user_id,
  u.name AS user_name,
  a.exception_date::TEXT,
  a.start_time,
  a.end_time,
  a.is_available,
  COUNT(*) OVER() AS total
FROM
  availability_exceptions a
INNER JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
WHERE
  -- 1. Buscador global existente protegido por paréntesis
  (
    COALESCE($1, '') = '' OR
    (
      u.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.exception_date::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.start_time::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.end_time::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    )
  )
  -- 2. NUEVO: Filtro opcional por user_id ($4)
  AND ($4 IS NULL OR $4::text = '' OR a.user_id = $4)
ORDER BY
  a.exception_date DESC
LIMIT
  {{ $2 || 100 }}
OFFSET
  {{ (($3 || 1) - 1) * ($2 || 100) }};

	a.summary,

parameters.content:
## Appointments – Reschedule

**POST** `/webhook/appointments/reschedule`

Cancels the original appointment and creates a new one in a single
transaction. Mirror of the `upsert` create payload plus the
`original_appointment_id` field.

**No side-effects in v1**: does NOT touch Google Calendar, does
NOT send notifications.

The link between the cancelled appointment and the new one is
NOT persisted as a relational FK — knowing the old was cancelled
with reason='reschedule' is enough.

**Cancellation:**
- old.status              = 'cancelled'
- old.cancellation_reason = 'reschedule'

**Creation:**
- new.status = 'scheduled'

**Eligibility:** the original must NOT be in a terminal state
(`completed`, `cancelled`, `no_show`). Otherwise → 409.

**Request body (same shape as upsert create + `original_appointment_id`):**
```json
{
  "original_appointment_id": "abc-123",
  "patient_id": "...",
  "patient_name": "...",
  "doctor_id": "...",
  "doctor_name": "...",
  "calendar_source_id": "...",
  "summary": "…",
  "notes": "…",
  "service_ids": ["svc-1", "svc-2"],
  "start": "2026-05-12T10:00:00",
  "end":   "2026-05-12T10:30:00",
  "changed_by": "user-id"
}
```

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "code": 200,
  "original_appointment_id": "abc-123",
  "new_appointment_id": "def-456"
}
```

## Appointments – Update Status

**POST** `/webhook/appointments/update_status`

Updates `appointments.status` and inserts an audit row in
`appointment_status_log`. No transition gating — the user is free
to move the appointment to any status. No side-effects (no Google
Calendar / no notifications).

**Allowed status values:**
- pending, scheduled, confirmed, arrived, in_progress,
  completed, no_show, cancelled

**No transition restrictions** — any source status can move to any
target status. The only no-op is staying in the same status.

**When status='cancelled', cancellation_reason is required:**
- late, in_time, no_notice, by_doctor, by_clinic, other
- 'reschedule' is BLOCKED here (only set by /appointments/reschedule)
- If reason='other', cancellation_note is required.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "appointment_id": "abc-123",
  "status": "cancelled",
  "cancellation_reason": "by_doctor",  // required if status='cancelled'
  "cancellation_note": "…",            // required if reason='other'
  "changed_by": "user-id",              // optional
  "note": "Notas extra para el log"     // optional, distinto del cancellation_note
}
```

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "code": 200,
  "appointment_id": "abc-123",
  "from_status": "scheduled",
  "status": "cancelled",
  "cancellation_reason": "by_doctor"
}
```

**Response 409 (no-op):**
```json
{ "error": true, "code": 409, "message": "Appointment is already in status \"cancelled\"" }
```

**Response 400 (validation error):**
```json
{ "error": true, "code": 400, "message": "cancellation_reason is required when status='cancelled'" }
```

SELECT id::text AS id, status
FROM appointments
WHERE id::text = '{{ $json.appointment_id }}'
LIMIT 1;

-- Atomic update + audit insert. Cancellation_reason/note travel together.
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE appointments
  SET status              = '{{ $json.to_status }}',
      cancellation_reason = NULLIF('{{ $json.cancellation_reason }}', 'null'),
      cancellation_note   = NULLIF('{{ $json.cancellation_note }}', 'null'),
      updated_at          = NOW()
  WHERE id::text = '{{ $json.appointment_id }}'
  RETURNING id::text AS id, status, cancellation_reason
)
INSERT INTO appointment_status_log (appointment_id, from_status, to_status, cancellation_reason, cancellation_note, changed_by, note)
SELECT
  '{{ $json.appointment_id }}',
  '{{ $json.from_status }}',
  '{{ $json.to_status }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.cancellation_reason }}', 'null'),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.cancellation_note }}', 'null'),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.changed_by }}', 'null'),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.note }}', 'null')
FROM updated
RETURNING appointment_id, from_status, to_status, cancellation_reason, changed_at::text AS changed_at;

SELECT
  id::text AS id,
  title,
  description,
  start_datetime::text AS start_datetime,
  end_datetime::text AS end_datetime,
  color,
  priority,
  status,
  visibility,

WHERE ({{ $json.from_sql }}::timestamp IS NULL OR start_datetime >= {{ $json.from_sql }}::timestamp)

## Reminders – Get

**GET** `/webhook/reminders`

Returns internal calendar reminders: the caller's own reminders (`created_by = jwt userId`) plus every `visibility = 'clinic'` reminder from any creator.

**Query params:**
- `from`: optional ISO/local datetime lower bound for `start_datetime`
- `to`: optional ISO/local datetime upper bound for `start_datetime`
- `status`: optional status filter (`pending`, `done`, `dismissed`, `cancelled`)
- `include_cancelled`: optional boolean; default false

**Response 200:** array of reminders using the frontend contract:
`id`, `title`, `description`, `start_datetime`, `end_datetime`, `color`, `priority`, `status`, `visibility` (`personal`|`clinic`), `raise_alert`, `alert_instance_id`, `created_by`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

## Reminders – Delete

**POST** `/webhook/reminders/delete`

Deletes an internal reminder. Only the creator (`created_by`, from the JWT) may delete it — a reminder owned by someone else, or a nonexistent id, returns 403.

**Request body:**
```json
{ "id": "reminder-uuid" }
```

This workflow only deletes the `reminders` row. Alert generation/cleanup is intentionally handled by the alert workflows/rules.

**Response 200:**
```json
{ "success": true, "code": 200, "id": "..." }
```

SELECT id
FROM public.appointments

    (start_datetime::date >= $1::date
     AND start_datetime::date < ($2::date + INTERVAL '1 day'))

    a.invoice_id,
    a.notes,
    a.quote_id,

FROM public.appointments a
INNER JOIN calendar_sources c ON c.id = a.calendar_source_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.patient_id
LEFT JOIN users rc ON rc.id = u.responsible_contact_id
LEFT JOIN users d ON d.id = a.assignee_id
-- Subconsulta para agregar los servicios por cada cita
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT

        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', sc.id,

WHERE (
  c.is_active IS TRUE 
  AND a.start_datetime >= $1 
  AND a.end_datetime <= $2
  AND ($3 IS NULL OR a.calendar_source_id = ANY (string_to_array($3, ',')::bigint[]))
  AND ($4 IS NULL OR a.patient_id = $4)
  AND ($6 IS NULL OR a.assignee_id = $6)
  AND $5 IS NULL
  AND a.status <> 'deleted'
)
OR ($5 IS NOT NULL AND a.id = $5)
SELECT id::text AS id, status FROM appointments WHERE id::text = $1 LIMIT 1;

-- Atomic reschedule: insert new + cancel old + 2 audit rows.
-- Values passed as query parameters ($1..$10) — no string interpolation.
WITH new_appt AS (
  INSERT INTO appointments (
    patient_id, assignee_id, calendar_source_id,
    start_datetime, end_datetime,
    summary, notes, status,
    created_at, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'scheduled', NOW(), NOW()
  )
  RETURNING id::text AS new_id
),
cancelled_old AS (
  UPDATE appointments
  SET status              = $11,
      cancellation_reason = 'reschedule',
      updated_at          = NOW()
  WHERE id::text = $8
  RETURNING id::text AS old_id
),
log_old AS (
  INSERT INTO appointment_status_log
    (appointment_id, from_status, to_status, cancellation_reason, changed_by, note)
  SELECT old_id, $9, 'cancelled', 'reschedule', $10, 'Reagendada'
  FROM cancelled_old
  RETURNING appointment_id
),
log_new AS (
  INSERT INTO appointment_status_log
    (appointment_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by, note)
  SELECT new_id, NULL, 'scheduled', $10, 'Creada por reagendamiento'
  FROM new_appt
  RETURNING appointment_id
)
SELECT (SELECT old_id FROM cancelled_old) AS old_id,
       (SELECT new_id FROM new_appt)     AS new_id;

INSERT INTO public.reminders AS existing (
  id,
  type,
  calendar_id,
  title,
  description,
  start_datetime,
  end_datetime,
  color,
  priority,
  status,
  visibility,
  raise_alert,
  created_by,
  completed_at,
  completed_by,
  created_at,
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  COALESCE($1::uuid, gen_random_uuid()),
  $2::character varying,
  $3::bigint,
  $4::text,
  $5::text,
  $6::timestamp,
  $7::timestamp,
  $8::character varying,
  $9::character varying,
  $10::character varying,
  $13::character varying,
  CASE WHEN $2::text = 'note' THEN FALSE ELSE $11::boolean END,
  $12::uuid,
  CASE WHEN $10::text = 'done' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
  CASE WHEN $10::text = 'done' THEN $12::uuid ELSE NULL END,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
SET type           = EXCLUDED.type,
    calendar_id    = EXCLUDED.calendar_id,
    title          = EXCLUDED.title,
    description    = EXCLUDED.description,
    start_datetime = EXCLUDED.start_datetime,
    end_datetime   = EXCLUDED.end_datetime,
    color          = EXCLUDED.color,
    priority       = EXCLUDED.priority,
    status         = EXCLUDED.status,
    visibility     = CASE
                       -- El alcance solo lo cambia el autor. Si B marcara "solo para mí"
                       -- un ítem de A, created_by seguiría siendo A: el ítem pasaría a ser
                       -- personal DE A y desaparecería del calendario de B, sin forma de
                       -- revertirlo desde la UI. Misma razón que isScopeLocked en el form.
                       WHEN existing.created_by IS NULL OR existing.created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by
                         THEN EXCLUDED.visibility
                       ELSE existing.visibility
                     END,
    raise_alert    = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.type = 'note' THEN FALSE ELSE EXCLUDED.raise_alert END,
    completed_at   = CASE
                       WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'done' THEN COALESCE(existing.completed_at, NOW())
                       ELSE NULL
                     END,
    completed_by   = CASE
                       WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'done' THEN COALESCE(existing.completed_by, EXCLUDED.completed_by)
                       ELSE NULL
                     END,
    updated_at     = NOW()
-- Lo compartido lo edita cualquiera; lo personal, solo su autor. EXCLUDED.created_by es
-- el actor del JWT, así que esto compara "lo guardado" contra "quien edita".
--
-- El IS NULL no es defensivo de más: `NULL = 'uuid'` da NULL, no false, así que sin él
-- las filas sin autor (viejas, o con el autor dado de baja — la FK es ON DELETE SET NULL)
-- no las podría editar nadie, nunca.
WHERE existing.visibility <> 'personal'
   OR existing.created_by IS NULL
   OR existing.created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by
RETURNING
  id::text AS id,
  type,
  calendar_id::text AS calendar_id,
  title,
  description,
  start_datetime::text AS start_datetime,
  end_datetime::text AS end_datetime,
  color,
  priority,
  status,
  visibility,
  raise_alert,
  alert_instance_id,
  created_by::text AS created_by,
  created_at::text AS created_at,
  updated_at::text AS updated_at,
  completed_at::text AS completed_at,
  completed_by::text AS completed_by;

## Reminders – Upsert

**POST** `/webhook/reminders/upsert`

Creates or updates a note or reminder. PostgreSQL receives every dynamic value through prepared-statement parameters; no request value is interpolated into SQL.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "id": "optional-uuid",
  "type": "note | reminder",
  "calendar_id": "42 | null",
  "title": "Llamar a laboratorio",
  "description": "Detalles opcionales",
  "start_datetime": "2026-05-13T13:45:00",
  "end_datetime": "2026-05-13T14:00:00",
  "color": "#5484ed",
  "priority": "MEDIUM",
  "status": "pending",
  "visibility": "clinic | personal",
  "raise_alert": true
}
```

**Alcance (`visibility`)**
- `clinic` (compartido, el default): lo edita cualquier usuario del staff.
- `personal`: solo lo edita su autor (`created_by`). Un ítem sin autor — filas viejas o
  cuyo autor fue dado de baja, la FK es `ON DELETE SET NULL` — se trata como compartido.

La autorización vive en el `ON CONFLICT ... WHERE`, y `visibility` solo la cambia el
autor. Misma regla que `canManageReminder` en el frontend y que el filtro del GET.

`calendar_id` is nullable. `created_by` and completion ownership come from the authenticated JWT, never from the request body. Notes always persist with `raise_alert = false`. Alert scheduling remains the responsibility of the alert workflows; this endpoint does not create `alert_instances`.

**Response 200:** `{ "success": true, "code": 200, "reminder": { ... } }`
**Response 403:** el ítem guardado es personal de otro usuario.

SELECT a.id AS appointment_id,
	a.summary,
	a.start_datetime AS start,
	a.end_datetime AS end,
	a.patient_id AS patient_id,
	u.name AS patient_name,
	u.phone_number AS patient_phone,
	u.email AS patient_email,
    u.identity_document as patient_identity_document,
    CASE WHEN u.responsible_contact_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        jsonb_build_object(
            'id', rc.id,
            'name', rc.name,
            'email', rc.email,
            'phone_number', rc.phone_number,
            'address', rc.address
        )
    ELSE NULL END AS responsible_contact,
	a.assignee_id AS doctor_id,
	d.name AS doctor_name,
	d.email AS doctor_email,
	a.description,
	a.status,
	a.cancellation_reason,
	a.cancellation_note,
	a.created_at,
	a.calendar_source_id,
	google_event_id AS google_event_id,
    a.color,
    a.invoice_id,
    a.notes,
    a.quote_id,
    a.imported_from_google,
    q.doc_no,
    COALESCE(s.services_array, '[]'::jsonb) AS services

FROM public.appointments a
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
        unaccent(lower(btrim($1::text)))                      AS term,
        regexp_replace(coalesce($1::text, ''), '\D', '', 'g') AS phone
) p
INNER JOIN calendar_sources c ON c.id = a.calendar_source_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.patient_id
LEFT JOIN users rc ON rc.id = u.responsible_contact_id
LEFT JOIN users d ON d.id = a.assignee_id
-- Subconsulta para agregar los servicios por cada cita
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        asc_t.appointment_id,
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', sc.id,
                'name', sc.name,
                'price', sc.price
            )
        ) AS services_array
    FROM appointment_service_catalog asc_t
    INNER JOIN service_catalog sc ON asc_t.service_id = sc.id
    GROUP BY asc_t.appointment_id
) s ON s.appointment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN quotes q ON a.quote_id = q.id

WHERE c.is_active IS TRUE
  AND a.status <> 'deleted'
  AND char_length(p.term) >= 2
  AND ($2 IS NULL OR $2 = '' OR a.calendar_source_id = ANY (string_to_array($2, ',')::bigint[]))
  AND (
        unaccent(lower(coalesce(a.summary, '')))     LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(a.notes, '')))       LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(a.description, ''))) LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(u.name, '')))        LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(u.email, '')))       LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(u.identity_document, ''))) LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR (char_length(p.phone) >= 3
         AND regexp_replace(coalesce(u.phone_number, ''), '\D', '', 'g') LIKE '%' || p.phone || '%')
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(q.doc_no::text, '')))  LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointment_service_catalog xasc
          INNER JOIN service_catalog xsc ON xsc.id = xasc.service_id
          WHERE xasc.appointment_id = a.id
            AND unaccent(lower(coalesce(xsc.name, ''))) LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
        )
  )
ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.start_datetime - now()::timestamp))) ASC
LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(coalesce($3::int, 50), 1), 100)

parameters.content:
## Calendar Status Display — Matriz de colores de estado

Configuración → Colores de Calendario. Fila por (clinic_id, calendar_id, status);
`calendar_id` NULL = matriz GENERAL de la clínica, no-NULL = override de ese
calendario (`calendar_sources.id`). Instalación single-tenant: no hay clinic_id
en el JWT, así que `clinic_id` se resuelve con `(SELECT id FROM public.clinic LIMIT 1)`.

**GET** `/webhook/calendar_status_display/search`
Devuelve todas las filas de la clínica (general + overrides).
```json
[{ "calendar_id": null, "status": "scheduled", "color": "#a78bfa", "calendar_mode": "always", "badge_style": "solid" }, …]
```

**POST** `/webhook/calendar_status_display/upsert`
Batch: guardar la matriz general (10 filas) o replicarla a N calendarios
(10·N filas) es SIEMPRE una sola llamada. La query hace INSERT … ON CONFLICT
con dos CTEs en un único statement (filas generales vs. de override), porque
son dos índices parciales distintos y no se puede apuntar a los dos con un solo
ON CONFLICT.
```json
{ "rows": [{ "calendar_id": null, "status": "scheduled", "color": "#a78bfa", "calendar_mode": "always", "badge_style": "solid" }, …] }
```

**POST** `/webhook/calendar_status_display/delete`
Borra TODO el override de un calendario ("Volver a usar la general").
```json
{ "calendar_id": "123" }
```

SELECT
  c.calendar_id::text AS calendar_id,
  c.status,
  c.color,
  c.calendar_mode,
  c.badge_style
FROM public.calendar_status_display c
WHERE c.clinic_id = (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY c.calendar_id NULLS FIRST, c.status;

WITH input_rows AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(
    calendar_id TEXT, status TEXT, color TEXT, calendar_mode TEXT, badge_style TEXT
  )
),
general AS (
  INSERT INTO public.calendar_status_display (clinic_id, calendar_id, status, color, calendar_mode, badge_style)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), NULL, r.status, r.color, r.calendar_mode, r.badge_style
  FROM input_rows r
  WHERE r.calendar_id IS NULL
  ON CONFLICT (clinic_id, status) WHERE calendar_id IS NULL
  DO UPDATE SET color = EXCLUDED.color, calendar_mode = EXCLUDED.calendar_mode, badge_style = EXCLUDED.badge_style, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
),
overrides AS (
  INSERT INTO public.calendar_status_display (clinic_id, calendar_id, status, color, calendar_mode, badge_style)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), r.calendar_id::bigint, r.status, r.color, r.calendar_mode, r.badge_style
  FROM input_rows r
  WHERE r.calendar_id IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (clinic_id, calendar_id, status) WHERE calendar_id IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET color = EXCLUDED.color, calendar_mode = EXCLUDED.calendar_mode, badge_style = EXCLUDED.badge_style, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM general)   AS general_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM overrides) AS override_rows;

DELETE FROM public.calendar_status_display
WHERE clinic_id = (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
  AND calendar_id = $1::bigint
RETURNING id;
